Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that the “over 60 million casualties” figure refers to World War I and treated the memorial as commemorating only WWI based on a single WMO entry. This misinterpreted casualty data (confusing mobilized figures with casualties) and ignored authoritative sources indicating the memorial commemorates both WWI and WWII and that the >60 million casualty figure is widely associated with World War II.
